title: Implement Codex human-message extraction
description:
Implement extraction: response_item records with payload type message and role user, concatenating input_text blocks; exclude harness-injected user content per the markers pinned in the verification task; never count event_msg user_message mirrors of response_item messages (community-verified on a real rollout that they are strict mirrors — counting both doubles the result); ignore turn_context, reasoning, function-call records, and unknown types tolerantly; every line must carry a timestamp per the rollout decoder.

Done when: golden extraction tests pass on fixtures including mirrors, injected items, unknown types, and malformed lines; mirrors count exactly once.
